name: Fondo FMA (competitive fund)
summary: Competitive fund of a Chilean foundation for biodiversity conservation projects in Chile, including mountain ecosystem restoration, watersheds and community-led protected areas, with team mentoring.

eligibility.rule: Individual applicants are at least 21 and Chilean or have temporary or permanent residency in Chile
Have completed and closed any current FMA-funded or supported project before applying
Demonstrate a previous track record in the project area or with local communities
Integrate natural sciences with other disciplines and different knowledge systems to achieve the project's objectives
Implement the project between December 2026 and August 2027
Project relates to at least one of the seven themes set for 2026-2027
Project is past the idea stage, already validated so it can be developed
No partners or collaborators linked to mining, pulp or timber, agricultural exploitation or other extractive industries

deadline.quote: Until August 24, 2026, applications will be received to participate in Fundación Mar Adentro's competitive fund

applicant_types.quote: Both individuals (applying independently or as part of a team) and legal entities-such as foundations, NGOs, institutions, organizations, associations, and similar entities-are eligible to apply.

geography.quote: Selected proposals must be carried out within the national territory between December 2026 and August 2027.

access.quote: Create an account through the application portal and follow the online application process.

amount.quote: Selected projects will receive a maximum amount of up to $6.000.000.- Chilean pesos for their implementation

consortium_required.quote: Both individuals (applying independently or as part of a team) and legal entities-such as foundations, NGOs, institutions, organizations, associations, and similar entities-are eligible to apply.

eligibility.quote: Must be at least 21 years old and hold either Chilean nationality or foreign nationality with temporary or permanent residency in Chile.
Individuals or teams that are currently implementing a project or program funded or supported by FMA are not eligible to apply until they have successfully completed and closed that project.
Demonstrate a previous track record in the project area and/or with local communities.
Integrate the natural sciences with other disciplines (such as the humanities, social sciences, the arts, among others) and different knowledge systems to achieve the project's objectives.
Implement the project between December 2026 and August 2027.
se han definido una serie de temáticas específicas que se buscan fomentar, y sólo serán admisibles proyectos que se relacionen al menos con una de estas
Proyectos en etapa de ideas, pues el requisito es que ya cuenten con una validación que les permita desarrollarse.
Proyectos con otros socios y/o colaboradores vinculados a las áreas de minería, industria papelera/maderera, explotación agrícola, u otras acciones extractivistas.

after_award.quote: Mantener comunicación con FMA a través de la entrega de informes de avance, gestión logística y financiera, y resultados de acuerdo a fechas y formato acordado al momento de la adjudicación.
Participar en un encuentro de intercambio de experiencias junto a los otros proyectos seleccionados del Fondo FMA.
